en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with a large industrial complex in the foreground, including a long multi‑storey factory building and a tall smokestack. Behind it lie numerous houses and larger town buildings on gently rolling hills. Dense trees and a rocky, wooded slope occupy the lower part of the image. The caption at the bottom left reads "Rabenau." and the publisher line at the bottom reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1905" with the number 5874.
